title: Flowing Fabric
description: Shanghai is one of the biggest cities in China with important social and cultural value. However, the development of Shanghai was uneven especially along Huangpu River. The high-rises in Lujiazui CBD shows agreat contract with the neo-classic buildings and high density Lilong residence in west bank.

In this design, we want to explore a new dimension of urban design-reconnecting the city without demolishing. By creating two new urban layers parallel to the existing context, a connected urban space reorganize the city and bringing a new possibility of urban life.
